item.title: Repo Storyteller
item.description:
Problem it solves

AI can turn a repository into a fluent but unverifiable project story. Repo Storyteller gathers file, commit, and implementation evidence first, then separates facts, inferences, and unknowns so a tutorial, fork, or unfinished configuration is not presented as original delivery.

Core capabilities

  • Codex Skill plus deterministic Python analyzer, runnable without an API key;
  • Distinguishes forks, tutorials, reference implementations, and actual changes;
  • Produces evidence-linked architecture, decisions, risks, and project narratives;
  • Read-only by default, skips sensitive files, and optionally supports OpenAI-compatible summaries;
  • Evaluates output through risk recall and evidence coverage.

Repository

→ https://github.com/BettyXu2001/repo-storyteller

item.title: Academic Writing Skills
item.description:
Problem it solves

Many academic-writing prompts optimize only the final prose. This suite treats a paper as a research pipeline in which claims depend on sources, methods, analyses, and reporting choices. Agents must distinguish full-text verification, abstract or metadata verification, user-provided evidence, analysis output, inference, and unverified material.

What is included

  • 1 orchestrator skill + 12 specialist skills, with write-academic-paper as the multi-stage entry point;
  • Covers research-question definition, literature review, study design, data analysis, thesis and journal-article writing, defense, submission, peer-review revision, and research-integrity audit;
  • Built for ChatGPT and Codex, following the open Agent Skills folder format (each skill is a self-contained directory anchored by a SKILL.md).

Scope

The suite does not fabricate citations, DOIs, page numbers, data, or reviewer comments. It maintains claim–evidence alignment and weakens or flags unsupported claims. Discipline-specific reporting standards, terminology, and methods must be supplied as project context. It does not replace domain expertise, ethical approval, statistical review, source verification, or authorship accountability.

item.title: Job Search Skills
item.description:
Problem it solves

Most job-search prompts and skills stop at resume polishing or generic interview questions. This suite treats job search as a reusable operating system: build a candidate evidence base, parse JDs into structured requirements, map evidence to requirements, adapt materials truthfully, and feed real interview outcomes back into later applications.

What is included

  • 2 orchestrator skills + 15 specialist skills, callable independently or composable into a full pipeline;
  • Works for internships, campus recruiting, experienced hiring, and career switching;
  • Includes a dedicated orchestrator for AI product manager, LLM application, Agent/RAG product, model platform, and AI evaluation roles.

Scope

The goal is not a fake-perfect resume. It is to make every application more explainable, evidence-based, and consistent. Users must supply their own real experience and materials — the suite does not fabricate.
